replay.method: load protected-development tree into an isolated temporary index and apply the candidate diff while excluding both legacy shared report paths
replay.projectionReplay: generate a new exact-revision content-addressed bundle from the synthetic merge checkout

commands: git diff b8f1e9ff13793140d2cad379e434379a9fcde98c c8cad62fe560d178cf085b13073d8880fdf58cda -- . <exclude legacy reports> | GIT_INDEX_FILE=<temporary> git apply --cached --check
limits: The closed PR is retained only as a historical reproducer; it is not reopened or mutated.
The source-only apply check proves conflict removal for this candidate topology, not semantic correctness of the candidate's unrelated source changes.
